## 能量去了哪里？ {.statement-slide}

<div class="big-question">能量释放 ≠ 有效毁伤</div>

<div class="one-line fragment">关键不是“总量”，而是能量如何进入材料、持续多久、走过哪条路径。</div>

<div class="scalar-row fragment">
  <span class="pill blue">Energy</span>
  <span class="pill cyan">Pressure</span>
  <span class="pill yellow">Impulse</span>
  <span class="pill red">Failure</span>
</div>

::: notes
本页建立第一个反直觉点：同样的总能量，不代表相同的材料响应。引出下一页的整体链条。

[Sources]
- Report.md Executive Summary: energy alone is a poor damage metric, L35-L35.
:::

# Backup Slides {.backup-title}

## Backup A — Rankine–Hugoniot jump conditions

For a planar shock moving at speed \(U_s\):

\[
\rho_0 U_s = \rho_1(U_s-u_p)
\]

\[
P_1-P_0=\rho_0 U_s u_p
\]

\[
e_1-e_0=\frac{1}{2}(P_1+P_0)\left(\frac{1}{\rho_0}-\frac{1}{\rho_1}\right)
\]

<div class="backup-note">Conservation gives admissible end states; EOS and constitutive physics supply closure.</div>

::: notes
[Sources]
- Report.md Conservation laws, L87-L107.
:::

## Backup B — Impedance reflection model

For normal incidence in a linear acoustic analogy:

\[
R_p = \frac{Z_2-Z_1}{Z_2+Z_1}, \qquad Z=\rho c
\]

\[
R_I \approx R_p^2, \qquad T_I \approx 1-R_I
\]

<div class="backup-note">This is a conceptual coupling model, not a nonlinear shock calculation.</div>

## Backup C — Energy, pressure, impulse, momentum

| Quantity | Main role | Why not sufficient |
|---|---|---|
| Energy | work / heat budget | ignores coupling and timescale |
| Pressure | instantaneous compression | ignores duration |
| Impulse | integrated momentum transfer | waveform matters |
| Strain rate | mechanism selection | needs stress, temperature, history |
| Plastic work | irreversible deformation | omits fracture and phase energy |

::: notes
[Sources]
- Report.md Energy-to-Damage table, L393-L406.
:::

## Backup D — EOS is closure, not magic

\[
P(V,E)=P_{\rm ref}(V)+\frac{\Gamma(V)}{V}\left[E-E_{\rm ref}(V)\right]
\]

<div class="backup-note">Mie–Grüneisen forms are useful, but complex phases, chemistry and nonequilibrium states require richer closure.</div>

::: notes
[Sources]
- Report.md Mie–Grüneisen closure, L117-L125.
:::

## Backup E — CJ / ZND conceptual frame

<div class="znd-line">
  <span>leading shock</span><span>→</span><span>reaction zone</span><span>→</span><span>reacted state</span>
</div>

\[
\rho w=j,\qquad P+\rho w^2=\mathrm{const.},\qquad h+\frac{w^2}{2}=\mathrm{const.}
\]

<div class="backup-note">Conservation constrains the wave; chemistry, EOS, microstructure and multidimensional dynamics determine the path.</div>

::: notes
[Sources]
- Report.md ZND-like formulation, L173-L213.
:::

## Backup F — Why high pressure is not strength-free

\[
\chi_s = \frac{Y}{P}
\]

<div class="backup-note">Small \(Y/P\) can justify pressure-dominated bulk motion, but deviatoric strength can still control localization, texture, phase pathway, release, spall and fragmentation.</div>

::: notes
[Sources]
- Report.md high pressure vs hydrodynamic distinction, L127-L140.
:::
